mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, account_id, order_id, trade_id, type, amount, balance_after, description, created_at FROM transactions WHERE user_id = #{userId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO transactions (id, user_id, account_id, order_id, trade_id, type, amount, balance_after, description, created_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{userId}, #{accountId}, #{orderId}, #{tradeId}, #{type}, #{amount}, #{balanceAfter}, #{description}, NOW())
